name: Gemalli
overview: Gemalli is a male figure from the tribe of Dan, known primarily as the father of Ammiel. His mention in Scripture is brief, with no additional personal details or notable events recorded. He serves as a genealogical link within the Danite lineage.
namesAndTitles: The name Gemalli means 'my reward,' reflecting a Hebrew proper name with no indication that it was divinely given. This meaning may suggest a personal or familial significance but is not expanded upon in the biblical text.
familyAndRelationships: Gemalli is identified as the father of Ammiel, establishing a direct paternal relationship. He is also noted as a descendant of the tribe of Dan, situating him within Israel's tribal structure. Beyond these, Scripture does not provide further family relationships.
scriptureSignificance: Gemalli's significance lies in his role as the father of Ammiel, who is mentioned in the context of the Israelite exploration of Canaan. Through this connection, Gemalli is part of the broader narrative of Israel's journey and inheritance. His mention underscores the importance of tribal identity and lineage in God's unfolding plan for His people.
